Veggie Quesadilla 
whole wheat quesadilla with mexican vegetable beans and paneer filling 

Nutrition: 
C: 32 | F: 12 | P: 17
Calories: 270 per portion 
Makes 6 quesadilla 

For the dough, 
100 grams whole wheat flour 
warm water, as needed
pinch of salt
1 tsp ghee

For the filling, 
mexican vegetable beans and paneer - recipe in a previous reel 
(one batch of the recipe is good for 6 quesadilla)
10-15 grams cheese per quesadilla 

serves best with salsa and sour cream
